statement.p: Suppose a, b, c, and x are positive numbers. Which of the following statements are true, and which are false?

li.p:
If \ln x =\ln 75 then x=75
?
True
False

If x=y then \ln x =\ln y
?
True
False
Note: \ln 4 + x = (\ln 4) + x\text{.} If we wanted two terms inside the logarithm function, we would need to write \ln (4 + x)\text{.}
